title: Cannot invoke String.length() because str is null error with ParentIdQueryBuilder

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

body:
On serverless we observed a couple of 500's with the message `Cannot invoke \"String.length()\" because \"str\" is null\`, caused by this line: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/21b0caaf13cf1d0dde5a85ef2a44917d3481d539/modules/parent-join/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/join/query/ParentIdQueryBuilder.java#L70

ES version: 8.13.0

I tried reproducing the error in a serverless environment with a [parent ID query](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/query-dsl-parent-id-query.html), but I didn't get past the syntax validation (`type` cannot be null).

Relevant stack trace:
```
"Failed to execute phase [query], all shards failed; shardFailures {[<redacted>][<redacted>][0]: org.elasticsearch.transport.SendRequestTransportException: [es-es-search-<redacted>][indices:data/read/search[phase/query]]
...
Caused by: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke \"String.length()\" because \"str\" is null
```
